# Agent skill (Microsoft)

VS Code's Agent Skills are the industry's [skills][industry.skill]: "folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that AI agents can load when relevant to perform specialized tasks", following the open Agent Skills standard ([Use Agent Skills in VS Code][m10]). They load in three levels, discovery, instructions and resources, and differ from custom instructions such as AGENTS.md and copilot-instructions.md, which are always applied.

## Examples

- Agent Skills, portable across Copilot in VS Code, Copilot CLI, the Copilot app and Codex ([Use Agent Skills in VS Code][m10]).
